sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a dense multimodal model from the Qwen3.5 family — same gated delta networks hybrid attention, vision encoder, 262K context, and MTP support as its larger siblings, but sized to fit comfortably on a single 24 GB GPU.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
sources.snippet: Try the newest Qwen3.8-Max-Preview, HappyHorse1.1, Deepseek V4 and GLM-5.2 models with the latest AI Token Plan. 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE flagship delivering a comprehensive leap in coding and professional work.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is Alibaba Cloud's efficient multimodal foundation model with 9B parameters, released February 2026. It uses a hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks and Gated Attention in an 8× (3×DeltaNet→FFN→1×Attention→FFN) pattern.
